cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. For the project report, my printer troubleshooting ranks above your restart suggestion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got everyone's invoices printed.

beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Implementation: second place. Identifying the blockage stays first.
